findings.location: Paragraph: "The first week after we moved to Haiti,..." (source.html paragraph describing people walking around the dead man)
findings.source_quote: But what shocked me the most was that no one seemed to notice. People by the hundreds busily walked around him, not even looking at the man—no one cared.
findings.suggested_fix: Correct the Afrikaans phrasing so it fluently conveys 'People by the hundreds busily walked around him'. Replace the problematic phrase with a natural Afrikaans rendering while preserving surrounding tags. Example replacement: "Mense in honderdtalle het besig om hom geloop, sonder om eers na die man te kyk—niemand het omgegee nie."
findings.translation_quote: Mense het honderde te wyte uitgeroer en besig verby hom geloop, sonder om eers na die man te kyk—niemand het omgegee nie.

findings.location: Paragraph: "This is just how it is; for most of us it is all we have ever known—the life of plenty."
findings.source_quote: This is just how it is; for most of us it is all we have ever known—the life of plenty.
findings.suggested_fix: Remove the accidental English article 'the' left before the Afrikaans phrase. Replace "the lewe van oorvloed" with correct Afrikaans "die lewe van oorvloed" so the sentence reads naturally.
findings.translation_quote: Dit is net hoe dit is; vir die meeste van ons is dit alles wat ons nog ooit geken het—the lewe van oorvloed.

findings.source_quote: And when we heard these things, both we, and they of that place, besought him not to go up to Jerusalem.
findings.suggested_fix: Fix the split verb form 'be smeek' which is nonstandard/incorrect in Afrikaans. Use a single correct past-tense verb form such as 'het ons hom gesmeek' or 'ons en die inwoners van daardie plek het hom gesmeek.' Ensure the quoted passage remains a faithful translation but grammatically correct: e.g. "En toe ons dit hoor, het ons en die inwoners van daardie plek hom gesmeek dat hy nie na Jerusalem moes gaan nie."
findings.translation_quote: En toe ons dit gehoord het, het ons en die inwoners van daardie plek hom be smeek om nie na Jerusalem op te gaan nie.
